'''Dien Suub''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who was one of the executives for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He once traveled to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], to attend the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]], the ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]''. He liked to read the ''[[Brentaal Trade News]]'' every morning, over breakfast.
